## Conventional Commit & Branch Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/): `<type>(<scope>): <description>` (e.g., `feat(api): add query pagination`, `fix(pool): handle timeout`)
- [ ] Source branch follows repository naming convention: `<category>/<description>` (e.g., `feature/...`, `bugfix/...`, `docs/...`)
- [ ] All unit, integration, and release test suites pass locally
- [ ] No sensitive credentials, private keys, or tokens are introduced
- [ ] Documentation and tests have been updated to reflect these changes
